dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - June 30, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**MLB Recap: June 30th**

The Chicago White Sox made a statement in Baltimore, taking down the Orioles 9-3 behind a strong team effort. Junior Perez led the way at the plate, going 1-for-4 with a home run and 3 RBIs. Meanwhile, Erick Fedde earned the win on the mound.

In Cleveland, the Texas Rangers edged out the Guardians 4-2, thanks in part to Jacob deGrom's dominant 7-inning performance. The right-hander struck out 9 and allowed just 2 earned runs.

The Philadelphia Phillies cruised to an 8-0 victory over the Pirates, with Cristopher Sanchez tossing 7 shutout innings and Trea Turner going 2-for-5 with a home run and 3 RBIs.

The Miami Marlins exploded for 14 runs in a 14-3 win over the Rockies, led by Eury Perez's 5.1 innings of one-run ball and Javier Sanoja's 3-hit, 3-RBI performance.
